verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official Bevy CLI. Bevy is described as a normal Rust dependency driven through the cargo workflow, and cargo is host-toolchain tooling rather than Bevy's own capability, so it earns no credit. A game engine could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
